resources.string: Helps people with sensory sensitivities by muting recognized ads and optionally covering them with a dark, still texture in YouTube, Tubi, and Plex. Reads accessibility labels locally. Optional YouTube controls use on-device screenshot text recognition on Android 11 or newer to activate explicit lower-right Skip ad, or Skip/Dismiss paired with Sponsored. Pixels and text are discarded; no recordings or uploads. Double-press Back to release protection and pause it for one minute. Detection may miss ads and is not a guarantee against flashes.
